hook: Missed Sunday's polio booth? Teams knock on *GHMC* doors till Nov 25
hook_b: Missed Sunday's polio booth? Teams knock on *GHMC* doors till Nov 25
tldr: After Sunday's booth day covered 17.21 lakh children in five districts, health teams visit GHMC homes on November 23-25 to reach those who missed it.

beats.what: Field workers will visit households in GHMC areas on November 23, 24 and 25 to give oral polio drops to children under five who missed the booths.
beats.why: The Sunday drive in Hyderabad, Rangareddy, Medchal Malkajgiri, Sangareddy and Hanamkonda hit 95.6% of its 18.01 lakh target.
beats.care: If a child under five at home missed the drops on Sunday, a health worker should come to your door by Tuesday.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: 7,428 booths, 245 transit points and 245 mobile teams ran on Sunday, with 29,712 vaccinators.
